About This Job
Home Instead East Hampshire and Midhurst are actively looking for a local resource pool of Live-in CAREGivers to register with us, to be placed to live in at a client's home when we have a placement ready and provide a variety of non-medical services to help them keep independent in their own home.
What does being a Live in CAREGiver involve?
•
Living in a client’s home for 2 weeks at a time or more
•
Offering conversation and companionship
•
Administration of medication
•
Assisting with personal care needs
•
Household duties such as cooking, cleaning and laundry
•
Arranging appointments and activities

Additional Information
Home Instead Senior Care Live-in  carers will provide one-one / individuals care for our clients who need regular daily additional support and assistance in day-to-day life.
While on placement you will receive £700 per week, hours are variable and assignments and are dependent on the need of the client. For each assignment you will be provided with a comfortable bedroom with reasonable amenities including a TV and WIFI.
This role requires one year previous experience in a care setting or a similar role.
Benefits of working for Home Instead Senior Care:
• Excellent pay
• Onboarding training
• Clients matched through hobbies and interests
• Paid mileage when taking client out
• Minimum 2-week placements (subject to client requirements)
• Rest time in line with working time directive
• 24 hour on-call support, 365 days of the year
• Refer a Friend Bonus Scheme of £200!
• Additional training available
• Employee Assistance Programme for 24/7 professional support
• Employment directly through us - we are not an agency!
There's only a few requirements from us...
• A full driving licence and access to a car (preferable)
• A desire to deliver the best possible care
• Aged 18 or over
• A good level of written and spoken English
Interested?
If you're looking for work which is extremely rewarding we would love to hear from you. For more information, please call Chloe on 01420 543214 or email chloe.gardiner@homeinstead.co.uk
Home Instead Senior Care is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of adults and expects all staff to share this commitment.
Employment is subject to enhanced DBS disclosure and reference checks.

This role reports to the Head of Information Security and requires a fast-learning and self-motivated individual to add capability and capacity to our small but highly effective team.

This role will help play a key part in implementing and improving the underlying processes required to provide a structured, systematic, and audited approach to Information Security across the firm. • Execute red team exercises to simulate real-world attack scenarios, testing the firm's detection and response capabilities both internal and external.
• Assess and test the security of internally deployed infrastructure IoT devices and sensors, identifying potential vulnerabilities and ensuring they are secure.

• Work with wider stakeholders on developing testing models for Generative A.I security.
• Work with wider teams to assess the security testing landscape and make sure we reduce vulnerabilities to minimise security incidents where appropriate and practical.

About This Job
Build and operate the interface, semantic layer and controls that let AI agents work inside IFS software safely.
Key responsibilities
•
Design and build MCP servers (Model Context Protocol, the emerging standard for exposing application capability to agents) over the product’s business objects, treating capability modelling, discoverability, versioning and backward compatibility as first-class design problems.
•
Build the write path that lets an agent safely change a customer’s operational data.
•
Build the semantic layer: an ontology and knowledge graph over the product, generated from what the platform already knows about itself and then curated industry by industry.
•
Build the skills layer that maps what someone asks for onto the correct operation and the correct sequence, with a router that picks between them.
•
Build the control plane: authentication, entitlements, agent identity, telemetry, metering, resistance to injection, and a default that denies rather than permits.
•
Build the evaluation harness that certifies agent behaviour against the real product, and improve the system against what it measures.
•
Build rapid prototypes and proofs of concept to validate emerging technology, product opportunities and customer scenarios.
•
Establish the engineering practices these systems need: evaluation, testing, observability, monitoring, governance, security and operational excellence.
•
Contribute to technical design, review other engineers’ work, and support colleagues coming into the domain.
•
Represent the work outside the team through customer engagements, demonstrations, industry events and partner collaboration.

Qualifications
Strong software engineering first. Everything else is applied on top of that.
•
Production experience building and operating enterprise systems, with real depth in distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, API and schema design, event-driven systems, security, observability and CI/CD.
•
Strong programming in a modern backend language. See the note on language under “Open calls” before advertising.
•
Experience delivering AI systems built on large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows and orchestration frameworks, including tool use, function calling, workflow orchestration and autonomous or multi-agent architectures, with the judgement to know where they fail.

Evaluation as a discipline: experimentation, benchmarking, prompt engineering, tracing, quality measurement and agent tuning, improving an agent against evidence rather than impression.
•
Ability to design solutions that integrate enterprise applications, business processes, workflows and data platforms.
•
Depth in at least one of the following:
•
Tool-surface and agent-runtime engineering. MCP servers, tool ecosystems, capability modelling, discoverability, governance, versioning, backward compatibility, multi-tenancy isolation.
•
Knowledge graphs and semantic modelling. Ontology design, context engineering, embeddings, vector databases, retrieval and search technologies, memory architectures, grounding strategies.

Enterprise platform depth. Oracle PL/SQL, OData, and comfort working inside large metadata-driven systems where behaviour is configured rather than coded.
Desirable
•
Experience with agent frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, AutoGen, PydanticAI, the OpenAI Agents SDK or CrewAI.

Experience building reusable AI platforms, MCP ecosystems or shared engineering capabilities used across multiple products and teams.

Containerised platforms and infrastructure automation: Docker, Kubernetes.

Experience with Azure, AWS, GCP or another hyperscale cloud platform.

Reverse-engineering or interpreter work.

Token-efficient agent design.

Enterprise software domains: enterprise asset management, service management, manufacturing, supply chain, aerospace and defence, energy, telecommunications, construction, industrial AI.

Contributions to open-source projects, technical communities, conferences, publications or standards.

About This Job
Reporting to the Senior Supply Chain Specialist, the Supply Chain Engineer will support the development, delivery and improvement of Mitsubishi Power’s regional supply chain across EMEA. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent Mechanical Engineering graduate, or an early-career engineer, who wants to build a specialist career in technical supply chain, supplier development and engineering services.
The role is not designed for someone who already has extensive supply chain experience. Instead, we are looking for someone with a strong mechanical engineering foundation, the ability to understand technical drawings and specifications, and the curiosity to learn how engineering, procurement, suppliers, quality and logistics work together to support major gas turbine, steam turbine and power generation service projects.
You will receive support and training to develop into a skilled Supply Chain Engineer, helping Mitsubishi Power EMEA source, develop and improve the supply of components, parts, consumables, tooling and spares across the region.
What will you do in the role?
• Support the development of the regional supply chain for engineering components, including parts, consumables, tooling and other spares.
• Review technical drawings, specifications and component information to help identify suitable supply chain and procurement routes.
• Work closely with Engineering, Repairs and Procurement teams to assess whether parts and components can be sourced locally or directly within the EMEA region.
• Develop your understanding of gas turbines, steam turbines and associated components, including materials, manufacturing methods and technical requirements.
• Help identify opportunities to reduce cost, improve lead times and strengthen supplier capability, while maintaining Mitsubishi Power’s quality standards.
• Support the resolution of supply chain issues from initial request through to delivery to site.
• Liaise with Engineering, Procurement, Quality, Inventory and Logistics, suppliers and Programme Management teams to help resolve technical and supply chain challenges.
• Build relationships with regional and global engineering and procurement colleagues, including teams based in Leeds, London and across the wider EMEA region.
• Support supplier and component development activities by gathering technical information, reviewing requirements and helping coordinate actions across internal teams.
• Prepare updates, reports and progress summaries for Supply Chain and Procurement management.
• Develop broader commercial and project awareness by working with departments such as Engineering, Programme Management, Procurement and Commercial.

Qualifications
What are we looking for?
We are looking for a recent graduate or early-career engineer who is keen to develop into a technical supply chain role. You do not need to have a background in supply chain or procurement, but you should have a genuine interest in how engineered components are sourced, manufactured, assessed and delivered.
You should be able to demonstrate:
• A degree or relevant qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or a closely related discipline.
• A good understanding of mechanical engineering principles.
• The ability to read and interpret technical and engineering drawings.
• An interest in materials, components, manufacturing methods and how engineering requirements are translated into supplier capability.
• A willingness to learn about gas turbines, steam turbines and power generation service technology.
• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to review information carefully and draw practical conclusions.
• Good written communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical updates and reports.
• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
• Strong verbal communication skills, with the confidence to liaise with colleagues across Engineering, Procurement, Quality, Logistics and Programme Management.
• A professional, diplomatic and collaborative approach.
• A self-driven mindset, with the ability to work independently while asking the right questions and learning from experienced colleagues.

Additional Information
At Mitsubishi Power EMEA, we are committed to building a workplace where people feel respected, included and able to contribute.
Our strength comes from the different experiences, perspectives and expertise of our people. Nationwide
Full-time
Life as an Army Mechanic offers much more than your average mechanic job. As one of our Vehicle Mechanics, you’ll be keeping the lifeline of our operations in good working order, wherever you are in the world, whatever the conditions. The impact your work has won’t stop at the end of the day – thanks to your careful maintenance, our vehicles can go out there to protect communities and keep nations safe. From tanks to quad bikes, HGV’s to Land Rovers, barracks to battlefield, you’ll be repairing some of the world’s most iconic and advanced military vehicles. As you work, live and train with your squad, you’ll enjoy friendships, experiences and opportunities like nothing else.
No matter your experience, background or skills, we need your drive and passion to keep our fleets intact. If you’re ready and willing, we want to hear from you.

Join us and you’ll start by learning the soldiering skills common to every member of the British Army, like outdoor survival and the safe handling of weapons. After this, you’ll head to Ministry of Defence Lyneham. Here, you’ll learn all the skills you need to be a mechanic – how to fix vehicles, carry out maintenance, repairs and inspections on tanks, trucks and quads. You’ll also get your car and HGV driving licences.

The Army can help you gain a range of qualifications. These could include:
• Level 3 Advanced Apprenticeship in Engineering Maintenance
• Level 5 Higher National Diploma in Engineering
• Qualifications at different levels, in Leadership and Management
• Car and HGV licences and opportunities for tracked vehicle and plant licences

- Earn a starting salary of around £15,985 during Basic Training which will rise to £20,400 after completing 26 weeks’ training or after completing your Initial Trade Training, if less than 26 weeks
- Receive subsidised accommodation and facilities, increasing your disposable income
- Receive free medical and dental health cover
- Have the continuous access promotional opportunity and to continually progress your career
- Be sponsored to earn valuable civilian-recognised qualifications
- Take part in Adventurous Training and be able to play your favourite sports.

• Regular Army age: 16.6 – 35.6 years
• Army Reserve age: 17.9 - 49.11 years

• GCSE Grade A–D/9-3 in at least English Language, Maths and Science
Fitness requirements:
• Mid-thigh pull of 94kg
• Medicine ball throw of 3.1m
• 2km run in 11min 15 sec (11 min 30 sec for Junior Entry)
Interests you’ll have:
• Mechanics
• Outdoor activities
• Helping people
• Travel
• Driving

jobs.smartrecruiters.com/wise/7440001515.description_excerpt:
About This Job
We're looking for an Engineering Lead to manage the Platform team within the Business Onboarding Verification (BOV) organisation — based in London. This team owns the platform rails that Business verification is built on; the sister team (BOV Global) uses those rails to ship customer-facing journeys and agent tooling. There are three organisations in the wider squad — Business Onboarding Verification, Personal Onboarding Verification, and Wise Platform Verification.
The scale we operate at
•
In FY2025, 15.6M people and businesses used Wise; we onboarded over 5.9M new customers (~500K/month) and moved £145B across borders (~£400M/day) across 160+ countries and 40+ currencies.
•
Our onboarding decisions gate ~£25B/year in cross-currency volume.
•
Verification is on the critical path for every new signup and for ~10 product teams across Wise that build on our rails today.
Our verification systems are not supporting tools — they are core production infrastructure that protects customers, enables growth, and must stay reliable under constant change in regulations, policies and evolving threat patterns.
The team you'll lead - Verification Platform
You will lead the Verification Platform (under BOV) team in London — a cross-functional engineering team whose mission is to provide the BOV platform (Onboarding Platform for business, requirement evaluation, collection, review, unified vendor integrations, repapering rails) that lets BoV Global and regional teams iterate safely and quickly on business verification without rebuilding plumbing. Concretely, this team owns three work-streams:
•
Onboarding Platform (for business) — modelling Business requirements as configuration-as-a-service, per legal-entity type (Ltd, LLC, Sole Trader, Partnership, Corp), with versioned rules and repapering / refresh rails so a policy change is a config choice, not a multi-quarter project.
•
Review tooling platform — the review surface on which Global (and regional teams) build their review flows; the foundation that makes AI-assisted review and review automation measurable and safe to roll out.
•
Unified Vendor Integrations — one observable, retryable, swappable gateway for registry, adverse media, website signal, Acceptable Use Policy and Business Onboarding data vendors, replacing today's point-to-point integrations.
Your mission
As the Engineering Lead for BOV Platform, you will:
•
Lead, coach and mentor a cross-functional team of engineers — supporting their growth, well-being and performance, and empowering them to do their best work.
•
Own the technical roadmap for the BOV platform — make sure it addresses real reliability, security and scalability concerns of the Business verification stack.
•
Partner deeply with BOV Global, Personal Onboarding, Wise Platform Verification and Mitigation Handling so the platform serves real product needs — not what the platform team thinks the platform should be.
•
Be an active contributor to delivery. Support day-to-day execution, get hands-on when the team absolutely needs it, and stay in touch with the technology stack — leading by example.
•
Own the health and productivity of the team, fostering a culture of ownership, transparency, bottom-up decision-making, collaboration and continuous improvement — the way Wise engineering works.
•
Own operational excellence. Ensure appropriate on-call rotas, SLAs, documentation and observability for platform services; run incidents in your area of ownership and turn each into a durable fix.
•
Collaborate globally with engineering leads across Global KYC and Onboarding (London, Tallinn, Budapest and Hyderabad) and the wider Wise engineering community.
•
Run the engineering rituals of the team so we stay agile and predictable in product development.
Why this is an exciting problem
Picture a pharmaceutical company incorporated in Singapore, with one shareholder living in Dubai, trading in the UK and Singapore. In one signup, that business touches at least four regulatory perimeters — Singapore, UK, UAE for the shareholder, plus industry-specific controls for pharma (enhanced due diligence, sanctions, source-of-funds). Our job is to work out — in real time — exactly what each regulator needs, verify it against the right sources, and hand the customer a signup that feels effortless. Now scale that across 160+ countries and the millions of businesses we have. BOV Platform is building the framework that makes this possible without a new (or at most minimal) codebase per market, and the interesting problems stack up:
•
Configuration-driven, versioned rules at scale. How do we express "what KYC do we need for entity type × country × industry × partner × risk tier?" as data — hot-reloadable, auditable, and safe to change weekly — while giving regulators a clean audit trail of which version passed which customer?
•
Distributed decisioning under real-world latency. A single verification decision fans out to 10+ internal services and external vendors (registry lookups, sanctions, PEP, document verification, ML models). Sagas, idempotency, timeouts, and graceful degradation all matter — because "we couldn't reach the sanctions provider" isn't an acceptable customer experience.
•
Consistency vs. availability on the KYC decision path. The same customer hits us from web, mobile and partner APIs concurrently. Where is strong consistency non-negotiable (a compliance-gated transfer) vs. eventual consistency fine (background re-screening)? How do we avoid decision drift across regions and entities?
•
Event-driven re-evaluation and repapering. Rules change; a country updates its policy; a customer's risk profile shifts. How do we re-decide retroactively across millions of customers without stampeding downstream systems or ops queues?
•
ML/AI in the loop — safely. Where does automation genuinely help (document classification, risk scoring, agent copilots), where does it not, and how do we ship it with safe fallbacks, clear observability and a human review path that doesn't become the bottleneck?
That's the problem your team will help solve — with real regulatory teeth, real customer impact, and enough platform surface area to keep senior engineers engaged for years.

Qualifications
A bit about you
•
You have proven experience leading and mentoring software engineers, including managing performance, well-being and growth, and handling difficult situations constructively (360 feedback, calibration, performance reviews).
•
You have built and led platform / infrastructure teams whose customers are other engineering teams — you know how to say no, how to prioritise for leverage, and how to keep a platform from turning into a bespoke-request queue.
•
You have solid Java (17+) knowledge and hands-on experience with Spring / Spring Boot, and you're happy to stay hands-on when the team needs it.
•
You have strong system-design skills with real experience of distributed, high-throughput, resilient services — event-driven architectures

Your new role
As an Experienced Senior Consultant Environmental Due Diligence, you will be part of our busy UK transactions team supporting fast-paced UK and global M&A transactions. You will assist with the identification of key EHS and ESG risks and opportunities and provide high-quality, targeted advice to clients on both buy-side and sell-side due diligence projects
Our team advises on transactions across a wide range of sectors, typically including industrial, commercial and infrastructure assets and businesses, often for finance sector clients. We work closely with in-house specialists across several EHS and ESG disciplines to provide targeted due diligence advice. Our clients use this advice to support negotiations during the bidding process and o to make informed impactful decisions on sustainability priorities post-acquisition.
You will play a key role in the team, principally delivering due diligence assessments, while also supporting project management and the development of client proposals.
Your key responsibilities will be:
• Preparation of proposals, including pricing/budgets and timescales. Participation in client discussions and support with developing new client relationships.
• Project Management and coordination of medium to large projects including multi-site projects over several geographies in support of buy-side and sell-side due diligence.
• Delivery of Phase I Environmental Site Assessments and Limited Environmental Compliance Review(LECR) assessments for a range of sites, including more complex manufacturing facilities; including participation in management calls, interpreting available information and preparing focussed client reports.
• Delivery of Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) assessments of companies in support of buy-side and sell-side due diligence. This will include desk-based research (review of data rooms and publicly available information), participation in management calls, interpreting available information and preparing client focussed reports.
About you
If you have relevant EHS/ESG knowledge, experience in due diligence and want to advance your career in a collaborative team, we would like to hear from you.What matters most to us:
• Relevant degree/qualifications. Ideally in environmental studies/geography or similar.
• Sound understanding of UK environmental regulations and an understanding of key environmental and sustainability regulations in Europe.
• 7 to 12 years of practical work experience in other companies where you have personally been involved in the delivery of Phase I Environmental Site Assessments, LECR assessments, ideally including to ASTM standards, and ideally also ESG assessments. Have the ability to understand information quickly and work efficiently, proactively and autonomously.
• Experience in supporting the preparation of proposals.
• Strong communication skills (both written and verbal), and be comfortable engaging with external clients and advisors.
• Project Management experience.
• A collaborative approach and willingness to travel, typically within the UK and Ireland.
What we can offer you
• Commitment to your development
• Leaders guided by our Leadership Principles
• A culture that welcomes you as the unique person you are
• Inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
• The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company
• Flexible work environment
• 27 days annual leave plus bank holidays
• Matched pension contributions
• Private medical cover and life assurance
Ready to join us?
Please submit your application and CV online. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.
We recognise that some candidates only apply when they tick every box. However, passion and potential often outweigh a perfect resume and Ramboll’s supportive learning culture can help you grow. So if this role resonates with you but you don't meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for this opportunity or another within our team.
Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll
Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll employs more than 18,000 people globally across 35 countries. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Buildings, Transport, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, Management Consulting, and Architecture & Landscape. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we help shape the societies of tomorrow.
Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion
Equality, diversity, and inclusion are at the heart of what we do. About This Job
We are looking for a Lead Payment Operations Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders. You will partner with our Payment Operations organisation to help drive data-driven decisions that would evaluate the current risks the organisation faces, interpret risk appetite and monitor and control for these risks.
The Payment Operations organisation is responsible for ensuring that our customers’ payments flow smoothly. The organisation focuses on resolving issues surrounding the movement of funds, to deliver a fast and convenient payment experience for our customers.
As a Lead Payment Operations Analyst, you will be driving our analytics effort to strengthen our risk frameworks. You will own the analytics strategy and models behind our Key Risk Indicator framework, design risk thresholds that support the organisation’s risk appetite and build control assurance models around our risky payment processing flows. You will also own the data behind the reconciliation of bank balances and customer funds to ensure that there are no material financial discrepancies. You will own the relationship with our Risk partners in the organisation..
This is a great opportunity for an analyst who has a keen understanding of risks, strong product thinking and is passionate about creating convincing analyses. You will also be part of a wider team of 150+ analysts that you can collaborate with on cross-team projects, have knowledge sharing sessions and bring ideas on how we can improve analytics across Wise.
This is an IC3 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here.
WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
•
Collaborate with various senior stakeholders in the organisation and effectively communicate your insights into real change for our customers. Join us in working towards our mission.
•
Support the organisation’s drive to stay ahead of potential risks by proactively identifying them, analysing the impact of these risks and proposing appropriate risk metrics to monitor and eventually manage these risks.
•
Proactively contribute to, own, create and track key metrics and results for the organisation, keeping them accountable throughout the quarter. For example, understanding each Key Risk Indicator and what the organisation can do to manage each of these risks.
•
Work with internal and external auditors, risk partners and stakeholders to test the effectiveness of existing controls. Be comfortable with communicating with multiple stakeholders, and helping them be assured, through data, of how these controls have worked.
•
Play a pivotal role in the prevention of financial losses and staying compliant through proactive identification of emerging data trends and insights.
•
Support the organisation by building and maintaining high quality data pipelines, preparing accurate reports, creating visualisations and delivering engaging presentations. Enable the organisation to discover insights from data by exposing it in a meaningful and actionable way.

Qualifications
•
You have experience with SQL and building data pipelines (dbt experience is preferable). You are confident working with complex data models and are able to independently design and implement new models.
•
You have strong quantitative skills. Ideally a background in statistics, mathematics, physics, engineering, analytics, computing, or any other scientific areas.
•
You have strong communication skills and an ability to translate business insights into persuasive analytical narratives that are simple to understand and that drives customer impact.
•
You have an ability to structure business problems with minimal supervision and prioritise problems collaboratively with stakeholders. You take ownership of your own impact on our customers.
•
Be proactive. You go beyond just the analysis and get things done.
•
You have experience with data visualisation tools (Looker, PowerBI, Tableau etc.) and demonstrate confident storytelling ability with data.
NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT ESSENTIAL
•
Fintech experience, specifically in the payments space (domestic, cross-border, cards, etc)
•
Experience working in risk analytics, control assurance or operational analytics
•
Experience with user-facing products and data
•
Python

Our functional specialists write reports which help the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) make important decisions about a person’s health and care.
Maybe you’re a nurse right now and you’d like to move away from direct care - this role offers you the chance to not only improve your assessment skills, but also to use your knowledge and experience to make important clinical recommendations. About This Job
About the role
We are looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer to join our growing Wise Platform team in London. The Wise Platform team works with top tier global financial institutions and major tech companies to offer Wise products and services directly to their customers.
Through our API, we help partners to architect and build integrations to our world class-leading international finance products, which in turn improves Wise Platform by increasing the capabilities of our public API.
This role will facilitate growth, troubleshoot and enhance the product offerings of Wise.
What will you be working on?
As part of the Wise Platform team, you’ll play a key role in providing technical consulting and product guidance to top tier banks and other partners integrating Wise into their products, primarily in a post-sale capacity.
You'll be:
•
Acting as a trusted advisor and conduit between partners and Wise where your technical expertise will enhance the product development and integration process.
•
Defining technical solutions, gathering requirements and supporting the delivery of integrations tailored to each partner’s needs.
•
Supporting partners during the bespoke implementation collaborating across teams to ensure smooth delivery.
•
Managing multiple integrations in parallel and navigating ambiguity.
You’ll also focus on:
•
Enhancing the integration experience for banking partners by developing comprehensive and user-friendly documentation, robust APIs, readily available SDKs, practical examples, clear code samples, and detailed reference implementations. This includes proactively identifying common integration challenges faced by banks and addressing them through improved resources and proactive support.
•
Working closely with the technical presales team to provide expert technical guidance and support throughout the sales cycle, playing a critical role in securing new partnerships by demonstrating the technical capabilities and benefits of Wise's solutions. This involves conducting technical presentations, demonstrations, and answering complex technical questions from potential partners.
•
Optimizing and streamlining internal processes to enhance team capacity and overall efficiency. This includes identifying areas for process improvement, developing and implementing new workflows, and leveraging automation tools to reduce manual tasks and improve turnaround times.
•
Designing and developing innovative new features that expand the functionality of Wise's services and exposing these features through the public API, enabling seamless integration with partner systems and empowering them to leverage the full potential of Wise's platform.
•
Diagnosing and resolving complex technical issues within the Wise product stack, providing second-line support to the API support team and ensuring timely resolution of partner inquiries and technical challenges. This requires in-depth knowledge of Wise's systems, debugging skills, and the ability to effectively communicate technical information.
•
Serving as the technical lead for complex partnerships, acting as a crucial intermediary between Wise's engineering teams and the partner's technical teams. This involves facilitating communication, coordinating technical activities, and ensuring alignment on technical requirements and solutions.
•
Establishing a robust feedback loop between the partner and Wise's product teams to gather valuable insights and drive continuous product improvements. This includes collecting partner feedback, analyzing usage patterns, and working with product managers to prioritize and implement enhancements that meet partner needs.
You should be someone who can think holistically about the ecosystem, while also being hands-on when required.
This role offers you the opportunity to:
•
Define your own path to success, with autonomy to create and drive your vision forward.
•
The opportunity to shape and innovate financial products across regions.
•
Identify problems and unlock opportunities for Wise and its partners through technology solutions.
•
Inspire teams internally and externally with your ideas, knowledge, and proactive attitude.
•
Travel to work with teams in Tallinn and London, as well as visit partners across the EMEA region.
If you thrive in a fast-paced, innovative, and at times chaotic environment and are excited about working with a diverse team to shape the future of financial integrations, this could be the perfect role for you.

System Architecture & Technical Leadership
- Define and own architectures for PMIC and advanced power converter products across multiple programs.

Modeling & Analysis
- Develop and maintain low-level and system-level models to support architecture decisions and risk reduction, using tools such as Simplis.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Collaborate with analog design, digital, verification, validation, test, and applications teams to ensure architecture intent is implemented and verified.
- Participate in design and architecture reviews and technical discussions across multiple programs.
- Provide technical guidance during silicon validation and system-level debug activities.
Documentation & Knowledge Capture
- Create and maintain architecture documentation, design guidelines, and best-practice references.

- Capture lessons learned, root causes, and preventive actions to improve future designs.
- Contribute to internal training, workshops, and technical knowledge-sharing activities.

Required Qualifications
- Strong experience in PMICs, DC/DC converters, or mixed-signal power systems.
- Experience with architecture definition and architectural analysis for power management products.
- Familiarity with modeling tools such as Simplis and Simulink.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and reviews.
Nice to Have
- Experience contributing to advanced power converter programs.
- Familiarity with emerging architectures such as Multi-Level Converter (MLC) topologies.
- Familiarity with multi-rail power systems and power sequencing.
- Experience supporting silicon bring-up, validation, and root-cause analysis.

- Architectures are clearly defined and consistently implemented across projects.

Job Description:
Head of Commercial - Contronics UK
Contronics is a leading provider of laboratory monitoring systems, calibration and temperature mapping services to NHS, healthcare and life science organisations. For over 30 years we have continued to deliver outstanding system reliability and unrivalled service standards. Contronics is part of Vesta Software Group, within Jonas Software Group and Constellation Software Inc.
The Head of Commercial is a dynamic, commercially driven leadership role, pivotal to the next stage of our growth. Reporting directly to the General Manager and forming part of the Senior Leadership Team, you will lead our Sales and Marketing functions, build new routes to market through distribution and reseller partners, and lead the commercial launch of new products. You will be central to delivering our ambitious year-on-year growth targets.
Job Responsibilities
Leadership & Strategy
• Lead the sales team and manage our marketing partner, building a high-performing, accountable culture aligned with our values.
• Define and deliver a commercial plan aligned with our business strategy and business objectives, covering direct sales, channel partners, marketing and new product launches.
• Broaden our customer base across private healthcare, biotech, pharma and research alongside our core NHS customers, and support growing international sales.
• Use market intelligence, competitor analysis and performance data to shape propositions, pricing and planning.
• Recruit, onboard and develop talent as the commercial team grows. Run regular 1:1s, performance reviews and team meetings to drive accountability and recognise success.
• Act as the commercial voice on the Senior Leadership Team, supporting business reporting, strategic planning and group-wide initiatives. Represent Contronics at industry events and in specialist forums.
Sales & Business Development
• Deliver sales targets for new customers and for new business within our existing customer base.
• Take a hands-on role in prospecting, leading and closing high-value opportunities, and set the standard for the team. As the business grows and succeeds, the role will move towards leading and developing a larger commercial team.
• Prioritise sales that build long-term recurring revenue and help customers scale with us as their needs grow.
• Diversify the customer portfolio to reduce reliance on any single customer or sector.
• Provide oversight and final review of tenders and proposals, including NHS and public-sector procurement frameworks, and make sure responses are compliant, competitive and high quality.
• Review and approve quotations and pricing within agreed margins and discount authority.
• Run regular pipeline reviews, keep the pipeline well qualified, and give accurate forecasts and full visibility of performance against target.
• Work closely with the Head of Operations to identify expansion opportunities in existing customers and to make sure new customers are handed over smoothly.
• Make sure every team member understands their contribution to team targets. Address underperformance quickly and celebrate success.
International Channel Partnerships
• Identify, recruit and contract distributors and resellers in target international markets.
• Deliver structured onboarding, product training, sales enablement and co-marketing so partners can sell with confidence.
• Set clear targets and agreements, review performance regularly, and act on underperformance.
• Develop international sales into a meaningful and growing contributor to company revenue.
• Make sure partners represent Contronics consistently and meet our brand, quality and compliance standards.
Product Launch
• Own the go-to-market plan for new products and propositions, from market validation through to launch and adoption.
• Define positioning, packaging and pricing that meet the needs of different customer segments.
• Work in close partnership with the Head of R&D and Product Owner so the product roadmap reflects market needs, customer feedback and commercial priorities.
• Make sure the sales team has the tools, training and launch materials it needs, working with our marketing partner on content.
• Measure Success Track adoption, revenue and customer feedback after launch, and refine the approach.
Marketing
• Own the Marketing Plan Create and deliver the annual marketing plan in line with commercial goals across UK and international markets.
• Manage Our Marketing Partner Set priorities, brief and manage the performance of our marketing partner, and ensure a clear return on investment.
• Strengthen Our Brand and Market Position Build Contronics' reputation as a trusted, respected authority in laboratory monitoring and compliance.
• Generate Demand Drive targeted campaigns, digital activity and lead generation, delivered with our marketing partner, that feed a well-qualified pipeline.
• Harness AI and Automation Use AI-driven tools for lead generation and scoring, campaign delivery and competitor monitoring.
• Shape Sales and Partner Messaging Define the key messages and content priorities for the sales team, channel partners and product launches. Brief our marketing partner and approve what they produce.
Job Qualifications, Skills and Experience
Essential
• Commercial Leadership: At least 5 years in a senior sales or commercial leadership role.
• Technical and Systems Sales: Proven success selling technical systems or solutions where compliance, regulation or quality standards are a key buying driver.
• New Business Growth: A track record of winning new customers and growing revenue from existing accounts, including closing high-value deals.
• Hands-On Selling: Comfortable leading from the front, prospecting and closing personally while leading and developing others.
• Commercial Acumen: Strong grasp of pricing, margins and recurring-revenue models, with the confidence to negotiate and influence at senior level.
• Tenders and Proposals: Experience of formal proposal and tender processes, ideally including public-sector procurement.
• Data and Reporting: Highly numerate, with experience of pipeline management, forecasting and CRM-driven reporting.
• Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, confident with customers, partners and internal teams.
• Travel: Willing to travel in the UK and internationally as required. Full UK driving licence.
Desirable
• Sector Knowledge: Experience in NHS, healthcare or life science markets.
• Channel Development: Experience of building and managing international distributor or reseller networks.
• Product Launch: Experience of taking new products or propositions to market.
• Marketing Management: Experience of setting marketing strategy and managing external marketing partners.
• AI and Sales Technology: Familiarity with AI-driven sales and marketing tools and automation.
Personal Characteristics and Company Values
• Positive and Resilient (Be Positive) Brings energy and optimism…

With your proven expertise in commercial claims handling, you will have the autonomy to manage a portfolio of both motor and non-motor claims from start to finish, ensuring the best possible outcome for our customers.

Collaborate closely with different teams within our company and external vendors to facilitate timely and efficient claims resolution. Your strong communication and coordination skills will be key in achieving positive outcomes.

Apply your analytical skills to analyse claims data, identify trends, and develop strategies to reduce risk, enhance our overall claims management processes, and decrease claim frequency.

Foster positive relationships with clients, brokers, insurers, and industry partners, dedicating yourself to improving customer satisfaction. Your commitment to excellent service will strengthen our reputation in the industry.

•
Present reports and presentations that highlight key performance indicators, demonstrating your ability to effectively communicate complex information to different individuals or groups involved.
•
Conduct on-site visits to clients in the event of a loss, investigating circumstances and building robust claims that lead to swift and favorable conclusions.
•
Negotiate with insurers to secure the best possible settlement terms under the policy, showcasing your advocacy skills and commitment to achieving optimal outcomes.

•

Minimum of 18 months experience in a similar claims role.

•
Your expertise in client relationship management is crucial in building and maintaining positive connections with our clients.
•
Understanding of general and legal principles of insurance will further enhance your effectiveness in this role.
•
Familiarity with relevant regulatory and legal frameworks is important to ensure compliance and adherence to industry standards.
Skills:

Your exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills are important for effectively handling claims.
•
Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills are important for effectively maintaining relationships with different individuals involved.
•
A customer-focused approach will be instrumental in delivering exceptional service to our clients.

Your ability to work independently, prioritise tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment will contribute to your success in this role.

Confidence, assertiveness, and resilience under pressure will enable you to navigate complicated situations with ease.
•
Your experience in providing care, offering emotional support, guidance, and reassurance to clients in difficult or distressing situations, is highly valued.

Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new

To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
Group/Division
The KLA Services team consists of Service Sales, Marketing, Spares Supply Chain Management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, Digital Solutions and Analytics, and Technical Product Support. Our services organization maximizes the value of our customers' KLA assets – with highly trained service and product support engineers providing installation services and 24/7 technical support and parts delivery through our extensive supply chain network.
What You'll Do
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
You'll be joining the Service team as part of the Product Support Organization (PSO). As a New Product Introduction (NPI) Engineer – (Product Support) and you will play a key role in the introduction of new products across SPTS's Etch, PVD, CVD, and Release Etch product portfolios.
Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Global Service teams, you will help ensure successful product deployment, service readiness, and seamless transition into sustaining support.
Purpose of the Role:
In this role, you will engage with multi-functional teams around the world to develop a plan to service these new products in the field.
KLA SPTS provides a dynamic workplace that encourages creativity and hands on approach while also providing opportunity for future growth and development.
This role represents an excellent opportunity for an experienced Engineer who are looking to develop their career in a fast-growing, award-winning, global semiconductor company!
Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
• Reduce program serviceability risk by acting as the Voice of Service throughout the Product Life Cycle (PLC) for new products by developing a service strategy that encompasses: Cost of Service Modeling, Reliability Modeling, Retrofits, Intellectual Property protections, calibrations, and PM Optimizations
• Build solid expertise in overall system operation, integration, and calibrations/diagnostics with a hands-on approach by learning from Tech Support Engineers and Design Engineers to better support Alpha & Beta Systems as well as retrofits.
• Start building a detailed Product Support Plan (PSP), Service Readiness Review (SRR), Design For Service (DFS) and Cost Of Service (COS) models, by working with engineering, marketing, finance, and service that details KLA’s strategy for supporting new products.
• Develop product service education and knowledge across the Product Support Organization using training classes, Augmented Reality (AR), individual coaching, documents, and other knowledge capture tools to elevate your co-worker’s readiness to serve.
• Conduct spares obsolescence risk analysis and coordinate with the Spares Planning team to build and start initiatives that mitigate Service supply chain risk, including closing known issues and collaboration with GSS Engineering and Operation team.
• Contribute to the service alert meetings and Plan of Action (POA) development for critical issues and other sustaining activities. Capture and document Best Known Method (BKM) and other improvements into knowledge database.
• Work closely with cross-divisional NPI Best Practice Team to improve and develop existing BKMs by participating in discussions, conducting training, and providing feedback.
• Actively manage and support beta installs in-person by auditing procedures, updating existing documents, identifying training gaps, and solving unforeseen problems as they arise to drive continuous improvement for future installs and upgrades.
Experience and Qualifications
• Ideally hold a MSc or BSc level Degree with relevant work experience.
• Experience in a Systems/Electrical/Mechanical or NPI/Process Engineer role.
• Strong analytic and data analysis skills.
• Knowledge or experience with industry standard problem solving methodologies and models.
• Motivated by helping others succeed, enjoys teaching, troubleshooting, working with groups of people, and explaining sophisticated things as simply as possible.
Occasional domestic and international travel (up to 30%), including to the United States, may be required as part of this role
What we will offer you?
Annual leave starting at 25 days (plus bank holidays), share scheme, contributory pension scheme, cash health plan, cycle to work scheme, global bonus plan, rewards scheme and life assurance
Minimum Qualifications
About KLA
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
Use of AI Statement
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.

• 5+ years of data engineering experience building, maintaining and working with data pipelines & ETL processes in big data environments.

ELT: Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Kafka

We're a rapidly growing global tech company headquartered in Canada, in the heart of downtown Toronto, with an office in Leeds, UK, and remote ecopeeps in the US. We get to work with some of North America and UK's leading professionals. Our colleagues are proud to bring their authentic selves to work, confident that what we do is grounded in a greater purpose. We’re always looking for curious, talented, and passionate people to join our team.
Who You’ll Be Joining:
Our Embedded Chapter is made up of 20+ Embedded Developers with a wide variety of specialties, skill sets, backgrounds, and experiences. They aim to bring their Embedded experience to the cross-functional squads that they are a part of, with a focus on collaboration, learning, and development.
As a Senior Embedded Engineer, you will be responsible for helping develop the software that powers our hardware products. These devices run on a multitude of platforms from small, battery-operated microcontrollers to full-blown multicore embedded Linux systems.
The embedded team is in a unique position as we own a wide breadth of the technologies that get built into our devices making each day a unique challenge. You may be working on portions of the low-level software/hardware interactions, but equally important is the development of the user applications that run on devices. Everything from network protocols to control algorithms to building enticing graphic UI’s.
The embedded team is also responsible for developing the test fixtures used to validate the functionality of each device manufactured. These devices are truly products on their own and no less complex considering the hardware and software systems they must interface with.
Aside from the in-house technologies, the embedded team is often also responsible for integrating third-party services. For example, we developed the device software stack that allowed us to become one of the first Apple HomeKit accessories on the market as well as more recently one of the first third parties to integrate Amazon Voice Services for Alexa functionality built right into a thermostat and on device Siri integration.
To accomplish all of this, at any given time you may be working closely with developers from other teams as well as our QA, Product Management, Manufacturing, Hardware teams and third-party tech companies on integrations.

• Conduct performance analysis and optimize system performance.
• Stay updated with industry trends to drive continuous innovation in home monitoring and camera technology.

• Proficiency in C and C++ development experience
• Knowledge of embedded Linux systems
• Extensive experience in embedded software application development
• Experience building Wi-Fi camera products is an asset
• Object-oriented design and coding skills with knowledge of data structures and design patterns Multi-threaded design and coding practices
• Knowledge of ARM architecture-based processors and development tools
• GUI development · Aptitude in programming for reliability and testability
• Knowledge of Home Automation, Control Systems or Internet of Things
• Knowledge of camera pipelines and image processing

As a Senior Sales Associate you will be the face of one of our most prestigious brands, providing a holistic shopping experience that is as unique as it is memorable. You will drive trade through building a loyal client base, arranging and hosting training sessions for the wider team, and delivering exceptional service standards.  You will raise the profile of the brand and build extensive networks across the store to maximise sales and eventing opportunities.
You will be the key point of contact with the brand representatives externally, compiling detailed weekly reports and building a trusted relationship. .
About You
As a exceptional retail professional, you will not only specialise in your own brand but will also have an in-depth appreciation of the wider industry and Harrods itself. You are driven by passion for our customers and delivering best in class service. You do this by putting customers at the heart of everything you do, building long-lasting client relationships and demonstrating exceptional product and Harrods knowledge. You will deliver excellence through detail, with proven experience in ensuring impeccable Visual Merchandising standards as well as diligent stock management.

• Self-motivation and be naturally curious, you will be keen to develop your product and industry knowledge
• An out-of-the-box mentality, to surprise and delight customers with exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills
• Exceptional organisational skills to keep the shop floor running smoothly
• Outstanding communication skills both written and verbal
• Ability to engage analytical approaches in driving the business of your brand, and have a genuine passion and interest.
About Us
Harrods is one of the world’s leading luxury department stores and we’re becoming a destination for top designers, and the most sought-after brands from around the globe. Our combined mission is to make visiting our iconic Knightsbridge store one of the world’s most inspiring shopping experiences.
Our Promise to You
Help us make the impossible possible for our customers and we’ll do something remarkable for you. As well as offering a friendly environment to inspire your best work, we provide abundant opportunities and support to build an exceptional career across the varied specialisms of our business.
Uniquely You
At Harrods we believe the personality and authenticity of our people sets us apart. We celebrate and invite applications from all cultures, backgrounds, tastes, and experiences and are proud of our culture where people from all walks of life can grow and thrive. What makes you unique makes us exceptional.
If you want to know more about life at Harrods, search #TogetherHarrods on LinkedIn, or follow us on Instagram @togetherharrods.

Seek out and drive new business opportunities with new-to-Gartner organizations across your territory, from initial client outreach to close, targeting Mid-Size Enterprise C-level stakeholders.

Convert viable prospects into active Gartner clients, owning the full sales conversation and negotiation, through to the transition of new clients to the account management team.

Align the right combination of insight, guidance and practical tools to bring value to the partnership.

Continually build a pipeline of high-quality opportunities to deliver against your sales metrics ensuring KPI’s are met.

Quota responsibility for your assigned territory.

Own forecasting and account planning on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.

1+ years’ B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments.

Experience selling to and/or influencing C-level executives.

Azenta UK, Ltd.
At Azenta, new ideas, new technologies and new ways of thinking are driving our future. Our customer focused culture encourages employees to embrace innovation and challenge the status quo with novel thinking and collaborative work relationships.
All we accomplish is grounded in our core values of Customer Focus, Achievement, Accountability, Teamwork, Employee Value and Integrity
Job Title
Shipping Coordinator
Job Description
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Shipping and Logistics Coordinator to join our Wotton, Surrey site. Reporting to the Global Warehouse and Inventory Manager, you’ll play a key role in ensuring the timely, compliant and cost-effective movement of manufactured and procured products, coordinating parcel and freight shipments across the UK, EU and Rest of World.
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 – 16:30
Onsite: Wotton, Nr Dorking (own transport required due to rural location)
What You'll Bring
• Book and coordinate all parcel and freight/pallet shipments, selecting the most appropriate carrier and service level for cost, speed and compliance.
• Handle shipments for all returns.
• Handle import/export compliance, including customs documentation, commercial invoices, and tariff/country of origin classification.
• Source, compare and document freight quotes, linking costs to customer invoices
• Coordinate weekly shipment consolidation for key accounts.
• Maintain delivery schedules, proactively chasing and resolving due date slippage.
• Track and report shipment costs, identifying trends or savings opportunities.
• Liaise with Sales, Customer Service/Planning, Warehouse and Finance to resolve shipping queries and ensure accurate order fulfilment.
• Maintain accurate shipping records and spreadsheets, supporting data integrity for reporting.
• Identify and support continuous improvement initiatives within the shipping function.
• Ensure all activity complies with relevant health & safety, export control and regulatory requirements.
What You'll Bring
• Proven experience in a shipping, freight or logistics coordination role, ideally within a regulated or manufacturing environment.
• Working knowledge of import/export documentation and trade/customs compliance.
• Strong Excel skills; comfortable working with data and spreadsheets daily.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to liaise across departments and with external carriers.
• Highly organised, with the ability to prioritise and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.
• Able to work independently and as part of a team.
• Experience with ERP/WMS systems (specifically Oracle Cloud) is an advantage.
If any applicant is unable to complete an application or respond to a job opening because of a disability, please email at Recruiting@azenta.com for assistance.
Azenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This company considers candidates regardless of race, color, age, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Salary: £30,500 + (DOE) + Benefits, including Private Medical Insurance
We’re looking for a Healthcare Assistant to join our friendly and supportive Primary Care Team at our clinic in London.
As a Healthcare Assistant you’ll support GPs in delivering patient medicals and GP consultations, by administering health function tests. Our Healthcare Assistants are also responsible for the day to day clinical governance tasks.
HCA Healthcare UK is renowned for delivering first-class private hospital care and for its expertise in managing complex medical cases. Beyond our hospitals, we are also a well-established, nationwide leader in Primary Care and Corporate Healthcare services, bringing high-quality, personalised care directly into the workplace.

• Perform routine health assessments, including blood pressure, glucose, and cholesterol checks.
• Conduct electrocardiograms (ECGs) and other cardiac tests.
• Respiratory function tests (spirometry).
• Phlebotomy procedures, collecting blood samples for laboratory analysis.
• Perform audiology
• ·Eye tests.
• Carry out drug and alcohol screening, including Chain of Custody urine
• Assist with mobility and posture assessments.
• Urinalysis to screen for metabolic and systemic conditions.
• Record essential patient health measurements, such as height, weight, BMI, and hydration levels.
• Simple wound dressings to include removal of sutures and clips, application of simple dressings
•  Ensure patient safety by implementing infection control protocols.
• Support clinicians with minor procedures as required.
•   To respond to clinical emergencies as required
What you'll bring:
• Previous Healthcare Assistant Experience.
• Strong administrative and organisational abilities.
• Confident working autonomously in a professional corporate environment.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office and general IT systems.

Why HCA UK?
Originally founded over 50 years ago by Dr Thomas Frist, HCA has gone on to become one of the world’s leading healthcare providers. In the UK, we’re one of the largest providers of privately funded healthcare and have invested over £500 million in the latest treatments, technology, techniques, medication and facilities. Being part of a large multisite, established healthcare group we can offer you unrivalled opportunities for career progression through internal and external courses, as well as working conditions that prioritise both your mental and physical wellbeing.
We believe that by caring for our employees, we empower them to provide exceptional care for our patients. That’s why we offer a host of flexible benefits that reflect the invaluable contribution they make every day. As a Healthcare Assistant you’ll be eligible for:
• 25 days holiday each year (plus bank holidays) increasing with service, with option to buy or sell leave to suit you
• Private Healthcare Insurance for treatment at our leading hospitals
• Private pension contribution which increases with length of service
• Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work scheme
• Group Life Assurance from day one
• Critical illness cover
• Enhanced Maternity and Paternity pay
• Corporate staff discount for all facilities including Maternity packages at The Portland
• Comprehensive range of flexible health, protection and lifestyle benefits to suit you
• Discounts with over 800 major retailers
Culture and values
At HCA UK we believe exceptional care starts with our people. We celebrate the unique perspectives and different experiences each of us bring as we know that when you feel seen, heard and supported you can be at your best for our patients, and each other.
Our mission is simple, above all else we’re committed to the care and improvement of human life, a clear statement that extends to both our patients and colleagues. To achieve this, we live and breathe four core values:

At Barings, we are as invested in our associates as we are in our clients. We recognize those who work diligently for us and reward them for personal and professional integrity, communication skills, distinct competencies and expertise in specific strategies, ability to collaborate as a team member and true dedication to the interests of our clients.
We thank you for your interest in joining the Barings team, and invite you to explore our current employment opportunities.
Job Title:  Head of Global Technology
Business Unit: Global Technology & Data
Location: Charlotte, NC or London, UK
Job Summary
Barings is seeking an accomplished senior technology leader, reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer to provide overall ownership and leadership of the Global Technology & Data business area. The Head of Global Technology will be accountable for setting and executing the firm’s technology strategy, ensuring resilient, secure and scalable technology operations, overseeing AI-related technology and application development, and enabling the business through modern data capabilities, disciplined delivery and strong partnership with senior stakeholders across the firm. The role will also have line management responsibility for the senior GTD leadership team.
Primary Responsibilities
This role requires a senior technology leader with broad enterprise experience and demonstrated operating acumen across Global Technology & Data. The successful candidate will provide leadership across Data Management, Cyber Security, IT Infrastructure Operations, Project Management and Technology Business Partnering, while ensuring that AI-related technology, application development and platform strategy are governed, prioritised and delivered in line with business and regulatory expectations. Primary responsibilities include:
·         Define and lead the multi-year Global Technology, Data and AI strategy, translating enterprise priorities into a clear roadmap, investment plan and measurable outcomes.
·         Own the Global Technology & Data operating model, ensuring strong governance, clear accountability, effective prioritisation and alignment with business, risk and regulatory expectations.
·         Lead the senior GTD leadership team, building a high-performing, collaborative function with disciplined delivery, strong engagement and clear succession planning.
·         Set the strategic direction for AI-related technology, application development and enabling platforms, ensuring secure, responsible and value-driven adoption across the firm.
·         Oversee enterprise data capabilities, including data management, analytics, governance and insight generation, to improve decision-making and operational effectiveness.

About Mimecast
The work people build is worth protecting, and it's harder to protect than it used to be. AI agents now move at machine speed with human-level access, and a small slip-up can become a very public one. We disrupt cybercriminal activity before that happens. Overview
Customer Development is looking for a Senior Sales Manager to lead, coach and develop a team of Commercial Account Managers responsible for protecting and growing revenue across Mimecast's existing customer base in EMEA. This is a high-velocity, data-led sales environment focused on upselling our expanding product portfolio, mitigating downsell and churn, and driving incremental growth.
Reporting to the Director, Customer Development EMEA, you'll be a customer-centric sales leader who delivers against quota through others. You'll establish a disciplined, evidence-based operating rhythm—rigorously inspecting pipeline, forecasting accurately, coaching live deals and holding the team to a consistent sales methodology—while developing talent and building strong customer and partner relationships.
This role is based from Mimecast's London, UK headquarters, with a minimum of two days per week in the office and travel for customer and account reviews throughout the year.
What You'll Do
• Own and deliver the team's monthly, quarterly and annual upsell revenue targets across the assigned book of business, while actively managing downsell, churn and net revenue retention.
• Drive sales of new technology into the existing customer base, identifying cross-sell, whitespace, account-penetration and incremental growth opportunities.
• Build and execute territory and account plans in partnership with Channel and Partner Development teams.
• Deliver accurate rolling six-month forecasts for upsell, downsell and churn, maintaining clear commit and best-case discipline at representative and team level.
• Run structured bi-weekly pipeline inspections, identifying stalled opportunities, testing qualification and driving clear next steps.
• Maintain strong CRM discipline and analyse week-over-week pipeline movement—including stage changes, close-date pushes, forecast changes and ARR movement—to identify and address risk early.
• Embed an end-to-end sales methodology and qualification framework, using call intelligence and CRM data to coach live opportunities and address the root causes of deal slippage.
• Set clear performance goals and lead a consistent coaching cadence through weekly one-to-ones, team meetings and enablement sessions.
• Attract, retain, train and motivate a diverse, high-performing team, developing talent from within and inspiring performance through words and actions.
• Build strong relationships with key customers, partners and cross-functional stakeholders, while providing accurate KPI reporting and management information to leadership.
What You'll Bring
• Demonstrable IT or SaaS sales and people-leadership experience, with the ability to lead direct, indirect and remote sales teams to revenue targets; experience in email, messaging, security or storage is helpful but not essential.
• A proven record of achieving revenue quota through others in a high-velocity, customer-focused commercial environment.
• Strong data literacy and forecasting rigor, with the ability to interrogate CRM and pipeline analytics—such as Salesforce and Snowflake dashboards—to inspect deals and drive decisions.
• Fluency in a recognised sales methodology and qualification framework, such as Force Management, MEDDPICC or similar, and the ability to embed it consistently across a team.
• Strong pipeline-management instincts, including the ability to identify risk early, maintain healthy coverage and lead accurate commit and best-case calls.
• An emotionally intelligent, coaching-led leadership style that sets clear expectations, holds people accountable and develops talent.
• Strong business and commercial acumen, including an understanding of corporate IT teams and buying processes.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and build credibility with customers and partners.
• A resilient, customer-centric and results-oriented approach, with the confidence and humility to operate in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
• Degree-level education is preferred but not required.
• Eligibility to work in the UK and the ability to work from Mimecast's London headquarters at least two days per week.

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. About CRFS
CRFS, part of Motorola Solutions, is a world leader in radio frequency (RF) technology, providing mission-critical solutions for defence, national security, and regulatory agencies. Our RFeye ecosystem - including ruggedized sensors, direction-finding arrays, and advanced software suites - allows our customers to detect, identify, and geolocate signals of interest in the most complex electromagnetic environments. We operate at the cutting edge of spectrum dominance, electronic warfare, and signal intelligence.
The Role
We have an opportunity for a Senior Software Product Manager to bridge the gap between complex engineering capabilities and real-world customer missions. This is not a "pure" product management role; it also requires some technical understanding of embedded and application software, as well as familiarity with electronic systems for RF mission applications.
You will be the "voice of the system", working closely with our engineering teams to develop innovative solutions to high-stakes problems. You will take ownership for some of our software products (both current and future), ensuring they not only have clear development roadmaps, but also solve the challenges faced by our global customer base and are the best they can be.
Key Responsibilities
• Software Solutions: Translate customer and partner requirements into actionable software product roadmaps and specifications, working collaboratively with Senior Engineering, Sales and Product Management colleagues.
• Product Owner:  As the owner and lead for Software Products (application and embedded) you will maintain a coherent roadmap across all software components, including real-time user applications, embedded real-time, APIs, and user-interfaces.  You will develop promotional content for the marketing team, and provide occasional support at trade events.
• Product Lifecycle Management (PLM): Support the technical evolution of our RFeye products from concept through to deployment and end-of-life.  Contribute to PLM activities to ensure that RFeye products meet customer requirements, are positioned and marketed effectively and that the CRFS Sales, Customer Support and Application Engineering teams are fully equipped and trained to sell and support them.
• Bridge Engineering & Commercial: Work alongside software and systems engineers to evaluate trade-offs, ensuring that engineering efforts align with market needs and commercial viability.
• Market & Application Insight: Develop a deep understanding of use-cases, including TDOA/AOA geolocation, signal capture and analysis, and electronic warfare support.
• Hands-on Product User:  You will be expected to use our products and become proficient in their use with a view to ensuring they are the best they can be – forming your own judgement on capabilities, improvements and updates using ‘customer eyes’.  You will also engage with end users to elicit their input and feedback.
• Documentation & Training: Author high-quality white papers, requirement specifications, and user stories. Ensure the Field Application Engineering (FAE) team is fully equipped to demonstrate new system capabilities.
Basic Requirements
Required Qualifications & Experience
• Education: A degree in Engineering (software/electronic/systems preferable) or a related technical field.
• Industry Experience: 3-5+ years of experience in a technical role, ideally within Wireless/RF, Telecommunications, Defence, or Aerospace.
• Technical Literacy: Strong foundational knowledge of RF systems (receivers, antennas, signal processing) and wireless communications.
• User and Solution Mindset: Proven ability to move beyond "features" and think about customer needs and solutions - how hardware and software interact to solve a specific end-user problem.  A demonstrable ability to understand and discuss technical concepts, manage trade-offs, and evaluate opportunistic new ideas against current commitments alongside cross-functional stakeholders.
• Communication and Approach:  Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. A positive attitude and ability to get things done, whilst being a committed team player.  An ability to build strong relationships and collaborate with colleagues and clients on product requirements and specifications.
• Product Management: While we welcome engineers looking to transition, prior experience in product management, technical sales support, or systems engineering is highly desirable.
Desirable Skills
• Direct experience with Spectrum Monitoring or Electronic Warfare (EW) applications.
• Understanding of deployable equipment use within a harsh or military environments and modern user interfaces.
• Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and tools like Jira.
• The ability to present complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders or customers.
• Source, compile and analyse market, voice of customer and competitor information.

Under 10%

None

Experienced
