Job Description:
About Us
Flui Technologies is a leading software solution provider to the energy and water sector, delivering innovative and scalable software infrastructure and services since 1990. Our solutions - MarketFlow, MeterFlow and DCC adapter - support market competition, smart metering, network flexibility and supplier integration across Energy Retail, Energy Networks and Water Retail, and are used to manage messaging for more than 35 million electricity and gas meter points, with millions of records processed per day.
As the utility sector evolves to meet the challenges of Net Zero, Smart Metering, Energy Code reform, Market-wide Half-Hourly Settlement, Demand-side Response and Embedded Generation, we combine deep industry knowledge with technical innovation to deliver robust, business-focused solutions backed by dedicated people and exceptional support. We are certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, reflecting our commitment to protecting data and managing risk.
The Role
The Head of Cloud Platform Engineering owns the operations and component-level architecture of Flui's AWS cloud estate - the infrastructure that underpins software processing critical market and metering data at national scale. This is a hands-on role: you will design, build and run cloud-native platforms combining AWS-native services with open-source components, and carry end-to-end accountability for how that estate performs, costs, and stands up to scrutiny.
Beyond architecture and operations, you will own FinOps and security for the cloud estate, and act as the accountable owner for its overall fitness for purpose - resilience, performance and scalability - as Flui's platforms scale to support a growing and increasingly complex utility market. You will work closely with the engineering leadership to ensure architecture decisions serve both the product roadmap and the operational realities of running critical infrastructure.
The role suits someone who wants to remain genuinely hands-on with design and build, while holding single-point accountability for how well the cloud estate is run, secured and paid for.
Job Responsibilities
The Head of Cloud Platform Engineering will report to the Technology Director and will be responsible for:
•
Owning the component-level architecture of Flui's AWS cloud estate, spanning AWS-native services and open-source/self-managed components (e.g. container orchestration, messaging, data stores, observability tooling).
•
Operating and continuously improving the platforms underpinning MarketFlow, MeterFlow and DCC adapter, with direct accountability for their resilience, performance and scalability at national-scale transaction volumes.
•
Designing and maintaining disaster recovery, high-availability and capacity plans appropriate to platforms supporting critical utility market infrastructure.
•
Owning FinOps for the cloud estate: cost visibility, forecasting, tagging and allocation, and driving measurable, ongoing cost optimisation without compromising reliability.
•
Owning cloud security posture: identity and access management, network security, encryption, vulnerability and patch management, and ensuring the estate operates in line with Flui's ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS and wider compliance obligations.
•
Defining and maintaining the non-functional standards ('fitness for purpose') that platforms must meet - resilience, performance, scalability and observability - and holding engineering teams to them through architecture review and guardrails.
•
Remaining hands-on: designing, building and, where appropriate, personally implementing infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines and platform tooling alongside the wider engineering team.
•
Owning operational rigor for the estate - incident management, on-call practice, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement of SRE practices.
•
Making and owning build-vs-buy and AWS-native-vs-open-source decisions, balancing cost, control, operability and vendor lock-in.
•
Managing key vendor and technical relationships, including AWS itself and providers of critical open-source or commercial platform tooling.
•
Partnering with the product/engineering leadership to ensure cloud architecture decisions support the product roadmap and time-to-market, and recruiting/developing a small, high-calibre platform engineering team as the estate grows.
•
Championing knowledge sharing and technical education across engineering - documenting architecture decisions and standards, running internal sessions on cloud and platform practice, and mentoring engineers and technical colleagues to raise the wider team's capability.
Essential Competencies and Experience
Business Acumen
•
Demonstrable experience owning cloud platforms supporting a regulated, high-availability or critical-infrastructure business.
•
Ability to balance technical excellence with commercial and operational reality - cost, risk, and delivery pace.
•
Understanding of the utility/energy sector's data and resilience expectations is an advantage.
Cloud Architecture & Platform Engineering
•
Deep, hands-on AWS expertise across compute, storage, networking, data and security services, ideally evidenced by current AWS certification(s).
•
Proven experience designing and operating cloud-native platforms that combine AWS-native services with open-source components (e.g. Kubernetes, Terraform, Kafka or equivalent messaging, Prometheus/Grafana or equivalent observability).
•
Track record of owning a FinOps practice and delivering demonstrable, sustained cloud cost savings.
•
Strong cloud security background - IAM, encryption, vulnerability management - and familiarity with compliance frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001.
•
Experience defining and meeting non-functional requirements: high availability, disaster recovery, performance/load testing and scalability at production scale.
General
•
Strong infrastructure-as-code skills (Terraform, CloudFormation or CDK) and mature CI/CD practice.
•
Comfortable operating hands-on day to day while also owning strategy, standards and team development.
•
A track record of sharing knowledge and raising technical capability across a team or wider engineering community - through documentation, mentoring, or internal training.
•
Willingness to participate in on-call/incident response as needed for platforms supporting critical services.
Job Qualifications
•
A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline is a bonus, or equivalent hands-on experience.
•
Current AWS certification(s) - e.g. Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional or Security Specialty - highly desirable.
Your Personal Characteristics Will Include
•
A pragmatic engineer-leader: hands-on by instinct, comfortable balancing strategic ownership with keyboard time.
•
Security and cost-conscious by default, without losing sight of reliability and delivery speed.
•
Calm and structured under pressure, with a methodical approach to incident response.
•

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
The Position
Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED)
WHO ARE WE:
Doing now what patients need next
We believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are courageous in both decision and action. And we believe that good business means a better world.
That is why we come to work each day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigour, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.
We are proud of who we are, what we do, and how we do it. We are many, working as one across functions, across companies, and across the world.
pRED CLINICAL OPERATIONS:
Our North Star is to increase R&D Productivity and Patient Inclusivity. This is supported by our CO Strategy to deliver value for pRED CO and our portfolio. We aspire to be a leading edge Clinical Operations organisation that drives innovative patient-inclusive approaches in study design and execution, utilises advanced analytics to drive data-driven decisions, and embeds innovative technologies into our ways of working to improve productivity delivery of programs and studies. We strive to create a workplace where team members own their own development and learning and are empowered to create and innovate.
ROLE PURPOSE:
As a Global Study Manager you will be assigned to pRED early phase clinical studies, and as part of a cross-functional study team, you will be responsible for delivering study management and clinical operations activities under the direction and leadership of a Study Management Team Leader.
Through your direct study responsibilities you will also contribute to the management of external stakeholder relationships by helping Roche to be the preferred sponsor for sites, patients and other important healthcare providers.
WHAT YOU WILL DO / EXPECTATIONS:
During your assignment you will participate as a member of the Study Management Team contributing to the delivery and execution of early phase study protocols. You will:
● DELIVER STUDY EXECUTION by providing operational expertise into protocol design and feasibility, country selection, patient centricity and data delivery plans in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. Ensure study quality and integrity by developing and maintaining study systems and documentation (including informed consent forms, communication plan, Trial Monitoring Plan, Trial Master File etc).
● PROVIDE COUNTRY OVERSIGHT, for insourced studies, by supporting or managing feasibility assessments to ensure countries and sites are selected for participation in studies. Provide guidance to country operational representatives during studies to ensure countries start-up on time and deliver on their recruitment commitments.
● MANAGE VENDOR PERFORMANCE by providing direction and actively managing relationships. Ensure vendors and third-party suppliers deliver against contracted scope of work and performance expectations and adhere to all appropriate standards (including ICH/GCP, SOPs and other regulations).
● PLAN DEMAND AND SUPPLY by overseeing the forecasting and maintenance of supplies (including IMP) needed to ensure sites have the necessary resources to run clinical studies.
● MANAGE RISK AND COMPLIANCE by assisting the study team in the identification, management and mitigation of study-related risks and issues in your areas of responsibility (including oversight of the risk, action and decision logs).
● DRIVE OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE by providing operational expertise across a range of operations-related activities that drive improvement and consistency in the execution of clinical studies.
HOW YOU WILL DO IT:
In Clinical Operations, mindset and behaviours are as important to us as skills and capabilities. You will succeed in the contractor Study Manager role by role modelling system thinking (connecting the bigger picture), agile behaviours (working flexibly, dealing with ambiguous situations, showing resilience), empowerment and accountability (using analytical thinking, tools, good judgement, and advice-seeking to make the right decisions), a growth mindset (fostering an exchange of ideas and experimentation) and creating value (helping to connect peers' work to a collective purpose).

Role overview
You'll own the end-to-end accounting for a group of more complex business areas. This means making sure the ledger is accurate, well controlled and properly explained, from month-end close through to year-end and supporting statutory reporting. You'll be the subject matter expert for your process area. You may review manage an Assistant Analyst and you will support the offshore RTR team.  A key element will be to lead improvements that make the close faster and more robust.
What you’ll do:
Entity and process ownership
• Own the month-end, quarter-end and year-end close for your entities or process area, and sign off results before they're submitted to Group.
• Review journals, accruals, provisions and complex judgement areas prepared by the team. Check that the accounting treatment follows SOX, IFRS and group policy.
• Analyse and explain P&L and balance sheet movements to Financial Controllers, FP&A and senior finance stakeholders.
Balance sheet integrity and review
• Review and approve balance sheet reconciliations, challenge aged or unexplained items, and drive them to resolution.
• Oversee intercompany matching, settlement and disputes for your entities.
• Look after your process area's technical accounting questions, such as new contracts, unusual transactions and policy changes, and escalate when needed.
Statutory reporting, audit and controls
• Act as the main contact for external auditors on your areas.
• Make sure key controls in your area are designed and operating effectively. Own the remediation of any control deficiencies.
Team leadership and development
• Act as the escalation point and reviewer for Senior Assistant Analysts as necessary and the offshore RTR team. Set clear standards for quality and documentation.
• Coach and develop colleagues through knowledge sharing, training and onboarding new team members.
Continuous improvement and change
• Lead improvement initiatives across the close, such as journal automation, reconciliation standardisation, and making better use of SAP, Power Automation and AI
• Represent A2R on finance transformation, system and organisational change projects. Assess the accounting and controls impact of each change.
• Track and report KPIs for your process area, such as timeliness, accuracy and aged items.
What you’ll bring:
•  Qualified accountant (CIMA, ACCA or ACA)
• Strong record-to-report experience in a large, multi-entity organisation, including review responsibility
• Sound knowledge of IFRS and financial controls
• Advanced Excel skills and strong ERP experience (SAP preferred)
• Confident communicator who can explain accounting issues clearly and challenge stakeholders constructively
• Proven ability to manage competing deadlines and prioritise effectively
Benefits and perks:
There's one thing people can't stop talking about when it comes to life at Sky: the perks. Here’s a taster:
• Free Sky TV or NOW package, including Sky Sports and Sky Cinema
• Pension package with up to 9% employer contribution
• Private healthcare with mental health support
• Aviva Digital GP and dental insurance
• Discounts on Sky products, including Sky Mobile, Sky Broadband, Sky Glass and Sky Protect
• Sharesave and Tech schemes
• A range of Sky VIP rewards and experiences

We've adopted a hybrid working approach to give more flexibility on where and how we work. The hybrid working expectations for this role are 2 days in the office per week.
Your office base:
Livingston
Sky Watermark is our central site for Livingston, sitting between Glasgow and Edinburgh. With vibrant office spaces, chill-out areas, and an onsite canteen, it’s a great place to work and connect.
The nearest train station is Livingston North. A Sky shuttle bus runs between the station and campus every 20 minutes throughout the day. Plus, there’s onsite parking available for cars, motorbikes and bicycles.
Who we are:
We’re Sky, a leading media and entertainment company who connect millions with entertainment, sports, news and arts through innovative products and services. Working with us means you’ll be bringing the joy of a better experience to more people, every day. All so we can do better and deliver better for our customers, colleagues and society.

About You

Who we are?
Linklaters is a global law firm, providing legal services in 20 countries and through 30 offices.
We have been named as one of The Times’ Top 50 Employers for Gender Equality for the 10th year running, recognised by Stonewall as a top 10 employer for LGBTQ+ inclusion, and by the Social Mobility Employer Index as a top employer for advancing social mobility.
Role overview
We are seeking an experienced Paralegal/Support Lawyer to join our Structured Finance Group. The successful candidate will support a broad range of structured finance and leveraged finance transactions, working closely with lawyers, clients, financial institutions and external advisers to deliver transactions efficiently and within tight deadlines.
This role would suit someone with prior transactional banking experience, ideally gained within a leading international law firm, who enjoys working in a fast-paced, deal-driven environment. Many transactions are time-sensitive and involve managing multiple competing priorities, making this an excellent opportunity for an individual who thrives under pressure and enjoys seeing matters through from inception to closing.
Given the international nature of the practice, flexibility to work outside standard UK business hours on occasion is important, including regular collaboration with colleagues and clients across Asia-Pacific time zones.
Key responsibilities
• Support the execution of structured finance and leveraged finance transactions from signing through to closing.
• Assist with the preparation, review and management of transaction documentation, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery of key work products.
• Coordinate transaction processes and manage critical workstreams across multiple stakeholders.
• Prepare and maintain transaction checklists, conditions precedent trackers, closing agendas and execution documents.
• Manage signing and closing processes, ensuring all documentation is executed correctly and transaction milestones are met.
• Liaise with clients, lenders, borrowers, trustees, financial institutions and external advisers to facilitate the smooth progression of transactions.
• Monitor transaction timetables and proactively identify and escalate issues that may impact delivery deadlines.
• Manage post-completion requirements, filing obligations and maintenance of transaction records.
• Provide regular transaction status updates to lawyers and other stakeholders.
Candidate requirements
• LPC, SQE, law degree or equivalent legal qualification (including foreign-qualified lawyers).
• Experience supporting complex financing transactions, including structured finance, leveraged finance, banking or other debt-related transactions.
• Strong understanding of transaction lifecycles, legal documentation and deal execution processes.
• Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple live transactions simultaneously.
• Comfortable working to tight deadlines within a high-volume, fast-paced transactional environment.
• A proactive and resilient approach, with the ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience liaising with lawyers, clients, financial institutions and external advisers.
• Flexibility to work longer hours when required to meet transaction deadlines and support cross-border deal teams, including overlap with Asia-Pacific time zones.
• Highly detail-oriented, with a strong commitment to quality and client service.
Third-party provider
Linklaters engages with a third-party provider for the provision of contractor and temporary staff. Therefore, upon acceptance of a temporary role at Linklaters, you will be engaged under a contract for services through our preferred third-party provider. You will not be employed by Linklaters, or have any employment or worker relationship with Linklaters.
Technical Skills
This list of duties and responsibilities above is not exhaustive.  It is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. As such, the role may also include the undertaking of additional tasks as required.
Application Policy
Applications and CVs (direct or via agency) are only accepted online via the portal. Queries related to this role must be directed to the recruitment team ( tempbtrecruitment@linklaters.com) and not partners, practices or stakeholders.

Job Description:
Senior Ecotoxicologist
Role Overview:
At Huntsman, we are currently looking for a Senior Ecotoxicologist to support our Global EHS Division. In this role, you will provide expert advice across Huntsman businesses by applying your professional judgement in ecotoxicology, exposure science and regulatory compliance. You will support the development and registration of Huntsman products by using hazard and exposure data to conduct environmental risk assessments, support evaluation and authorization processes, and ensure our products remain compliant with global regulatory requirements.
This position is open in multiple European locations: United Kingdom, France, Netherlands Switzerland and Germany. Remote work is an option, and due to the global scope of the role, travel of up to 20% may be required.
Do you think you’re the right fit for this opportunity? Apply today!
Role Responsibilities:
As a Senior Ecotoxicologist, you will:
•
Support Huntsman divisions with environmental hazard and risk assessment expertise across all stages of product development, including R&D of new chemicals, products, markets and uses.
•
Apply knowledge of global regulatory requirements, including TSCA, REACH, Canada, Korea and China, and collaborate with regulatory specialists to ensure compliance.
•
Monitor external ecotoxicology and environmental fate studies, ensuring the appropriate laboratory selection in line with internal and external guidelines.
•
Use in silico tools such as QSAR and read-across for screening, prioritization and, where appropriate, regulatory endpoint data submission.
•
Prepare and support dossier submissions in IUCLID and other relevant formats, including read-across approaches for environmental fate and ecotoxicity endpoint data requirements.
•
Act as the technical lead for ecotoxicology-related issue management, substance defense and advocacy strategies with regulatory bodies.
•
Maintain expertise in ecotoxicology, environmental fate and risk assessment, keeping up to date with relevant regulations, legislation and emerging environmental hazard issues.
•
Represent Huntsman in industry consortia and trade associations, actively participating in meetings and sharing relevant insights with internal stakeholders.
Experience and Competencies:
Minimum Qualifications
•
Advanced degree, Master or PhD, with 10 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in an international company in the chemical or pharmaceutical sector, or at a contract research organization.
•
Extensive applied experience in regulatory ecotoxicology, risk assessment and defense of self-classification and labelling under GHS and CLP.
•
Knowledge of ecotoxicological and environmental fate methods and guidelines, as well as the use of in silico tools, QSARs and read-across.
•
Extensive experience with EU REACH, TSCA and Canada chemical registration.
•
Practical experience with relevant software tools such as OECD QSAR Toolbox, IUCLID, CHESAR and easyTRA.
•
Experience with consortia and trade association work.
•
Fluency in English. Ability to work with colleagues globally in a multicultural environment and in a hybrid setting is essential.
Preferred Qualifications
•
Experience managing teams of scientists.
•
Professional certification as an ecotoxicologist or environmental scientist is a plus.
•
Practical experience with China and Korea chemical registration is a plus.
•
Previous environmental laboratory experience on environmental safety assays is desirable.
What next?
If you would like to join an innovative, collaborative and multicultural team, please apply now. Your application will be forwarded to a Talent Acquisition Partner, who will strive to get back to you as soon as they can. We understand that applying for a new job is a big decision and we will work hard to keep you updated and support you along the way.

At Huntsman, we pride ourselves on being a people-oriented organization.
Our family-like atmosphere is cultivated by our diverse groups of team members around the world.
We welcome the talent, experience and fresh ideas that employees at all stages of their careers, from interns to seasoned professionals, bring to Huntsman.

Job Title
Senior Scientist – Gene Editing (Bioprocessing R&D)
Location(s)
Cambridge (UK)
About Us
Revvity is a developer and provider of end-to-end solutions designed to help scientists, researchers, and clinicians solve the world’s greatest health challenges. We pair the enthusiasm of an industry disruptor with the experience of a longtime leader. Our team of 11,000+ colleagues from around the globe are vital to our success and the reason we’re able to push boundaries in pursuit of better human health.
Find your future at Revvity
Revvity's Bioprocessing department is at the forefront of developing advanced expression platforms to enable the manufacturing of next-generation biotherapeutics. We offer a diverse portfolio of mammalian host cell lines and innovative expression technologies designed for rapid identification of high-expressing recombinant clones. Leveraging extensive expertise in gene editing and cell line engineering, we deliver custom solutions tailored to our clients' unique manufacturing needs, for both protein and viral vector therapeutics.
Job Summary
As a Senior Scientist in the Bioprocessing R&D team, you will be primarily responsible for executing gene editing projects in mammalian bioproduction cell lines on behalf of clients, applying your expertise to design and implement targeted knockout (KO) and knock-in (KI) strategies. Working to defined project timelines and client requirements, you will bring strong technical independence and a delivery-focused mindset to ensure high-quality outcomes.
In addition to gene editing, you may also contribute to cell line development projects supporting the generation of expressing mammalian cell lines, broadening the scope of your impact within the team.
This is a hands-on, lab-based role suited to a scientist who thrives in a client-project environment, is comfortable working independently to deadlines, and brings a rigorous and methodical approach to experimental design and execution.
Key Responsibilities
• Design and execute gene editing strategies for KO and KI applications in mammalian bioproduction cell lines, planning and troubleshooting experiments to deliver high-quality, reproducible outcomes within agreed project timelines.
• Independently manage assigned project workstreams, ensuring timely delivery and maintaining clear communication with internal project teams.
• Analyse and interpret experimental data, drawing well-reasoned conclusions and proposing appropriate next steps.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date laboratory records, including laboratory notebooks and relevant technical documentation such as SOPs and experimental reports.
• Communicate scientific results clearly and concisely in internal project meetings and written reports.
• Collaborate effectively with colleagues across the Bioprocessing team and wider organisation to support project delivery.
• Where required, contribute to cell line development activities supporting the generation of expressing mammalian cell lines for client projects.
Essential Competencies & Requirements
• MSc with PhD or equivalent experience in a relevant scientific discipline (Life Sciences, Biochemical Engineering, or closely related field).
• Demonstrated, hands-on expertise in gene editing with a strong track record of designing and executing KO and KI strategies in mammalian cell lines.
• Solid molecular biology skills, including proficiency in cloning techniques (e.g., Gibson Assembly, Golden Gate Assembly), PCR, qPCR, and ddPCR.
• Proven ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and deliver results within defined project timelines.
• Strong experimental design and data analysis skills
• Highly organised, detail-oriented, and committed to producing reliable, reproducible scientific results.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present data clearly to internal stakeholders.
• Collaborative team player with a proactive and solution-focused approach.
Desirable Competencies & Requirements
• Experience in CHO cell line development and/or generation of expressing recombinant cell lines (stable pools and/or clones).
• Prior experience working in a client-facing or service-oriented research environment.
• Experience working in GLP or cGMP environments or a strong quality mindset aligned to regulated processes.

The Change Readiness Lead is the senior change leader on the program responsible for defining and driving the program’s change strategy, readiness approach, governance, and delivery standards to ensure a consistent, high-quality, and business-focused change experience across functions and business units.
Reporting directly to the Program Change Director, the Change Readiness Lead owns the quality, consistency, and rigour of functional change outputs, establishes and governs the Program readiness framework and criteria, standardises key capability interventions such as the Key User journey, and manages the day-to-day delivery, tracking, and governance of the integrated change plan.
How you will contribute
You will:
•
Change Strategy & Approach: Define and own the Program Change Management Strategy, business engagement approach, and operating model — and establish the methodology, templates, and toolkits used by all Functional and BU Change Leads.
•
Readiness Framework & Governance: Define go-live gate criteria and the readiness assessment approach; consolidate readiness inputs from all FCLs and BCLs into a Program-level view; chair readiness forums and report status to the Program Change Director.
•
CIA Quality Assurance: Own the QA process for all Change Impact Assessments and key change deliverables — reviewing for rigour, completeness, and consistency, and providing structured feedback before materials are used in governance or shared with stakeholders.
•
Key User Journey Standardisation: Define and standardise the end-to-end Key User Learning Journey across functions and BUs; set measurable go/no-go criteria for Key User readiness and monitor Program-wide completion and confidence.

Change Plan Management: Own the Program-wide Change Plan, manage cross-workstream dependencies, run the change team's operating rhythm, and produce consolidated change status reports to the Program Change Director.

Risk & Issue Management: Own the Program-level change risk and issues log — ensuring owners and mitigations are assigned and escalating systemic risks with root cause analysis and proposed interventions.

Team Leadership: Directly lead, manage, and develop the Functional Change Lead team; hold BU Change Leads to Program standards through governance and QA; collaborate as a peer with the Training Lead and Communications Lead.

Program Representation: Represent change and readiness at design authority, Program leadership forums, and steering committee; act as deputy to the Program Change Director when required.

Capability Building: Build lasting organisational change capability — develop frameworks and standards that outlast the Program and leave the organisation better equipped to manage change independently.

Strategic Acumen: Demonstrated ability to design and own a Program-level change strategy — not just execute within one defined by others — and translate strategic objectives into an actionable, governed delivery plan.

Leadership Presence: Confidence to lead, challenge, and align senior stakeholders at Program Director, C-suite, and steering committee level; proven people leadership of a change team.

Quality & Rigour: Demonstrable experience quality-assuring change deliverables (CIAs, Personas, Change Action Plans) and coaching others to improve quality; able to define and defend a high standard.

Readiness Governance: Experience defining and governing a Program readiness framework including assessment criteria, scoring methodology, and go-live gate standards across multiple functions or business units.
•
Analytics & Reporting: Ability to consolidate data from multiple change workstreams into clear, governance-ready dashboards and status reports for senior leadership and steering committee audiences.
•
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to translate change complexity into clear, authoritative, and audience-appropriate messaging.
•
Tools & Systems: Proficiency in Program management tools (MS Project, Smartsheet, Jira) and collaboration platforms (SharePoint, Teams, Confluence).
•
Handling complexity: Comfortable working in a matrixed environment across multiple functions and business units, managing ambiguity and competing priorities at Program pace.
•
System implementation exposure: Familiarity with the specific platform being implemented (e.g. SAP, Oracle, Salesforce) and the change challenges it presents is highly preferred.

We are looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with operational discipline — able to set direction and standards for the team, while also rolling up their sleeves to keep the Program on track at pace.

Strong program-level planning and risk management capability.

• Partner closely with Engineering teams to define, prioritize, and deliver technology capabilities supporting the Credit investment platform.

The Senior Machine Learning Scientist sits on the Lodging Search Ranking AI team in the Expedia Product & Technology division of Expedia Group. At the heart of the 3-side marketplace (the traveler, the property owners and the platform), this team develops and optimizes ranking models  with state-of-the-art machine learning / genAI techniques to power lodging search and personalized lodging ranking/recommendations for the multiple brands and lines of business in our portfolio.

We collaborate closely with the analytics, product, and engineering teams.
In this role, you will:
• Design, develop, and apply machine learning solutions to real-world personalization, product, and business problems, translating ambiguous opportunities into scalable models, experiments, and production-ready capabilities
• Drive end-to-end scientific work across problem formulation, data exploration, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, and iteration, with strong attention to measurable impact

• Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve outcomes, including familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products
• Stay informed about relevant advancements in recommender systems and relevance algorithms through ongoing research and learning
• Contribute deep technical expertise across related domains, helping raise scientific and engineering quality through experimentation, documentation, mentoring, and reusable approaches that support broader team effectiveness

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience
• 8+ years of relevant professional experience
• Demonstrated ownership of machine learning solutions at the service or multi-service level, including problem definition, model development, evaluation, and operationalization within a product or technical domain
• Strong foundation in machine learning methods, statistical analysis, experimentation, and data-driven decision making, with hands-on coding experience in scientific and production-oriented environments
• Experience working with cross-functional partners to deploy technical solutions, with core expectations in scalable model development, data modelling, and integration into software systems
Preferred Qualifications:
• Advanced degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
• Experience delivering machine learning solutions at scale, including architecture considerations, production monitoring, model lifecycle management, and operational excellence in live environments
• Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction within a domain through rigorous experimentation, strong scientific reasoning, pragmatic solution design, and clear communication with cross-functional partners
• Strong experience with recommendation, ranking, retrieval, search, personalization, ads, marketplace, e-commerce, or similarly complex applied ML systems
• Experience with neural recommendation systems, sequential or session-based recommendation, transformer-based recommenders, semantic retrieval, generative retrieval, or representation learning at scale

To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
Group/Division
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The SPTS division provides advanced wafer processing solutions—including etch, deposition and vapor-based technologies—designed for R&D through high-volume production. With a global presence and strong customer support network, SPTS helps manufacturers across industries improve performance, yield and cost-efficiency. It also offers comprehensive service and spare parts through a worldwide network of service centers and qualified local agents.
What You'll Do
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
Working as part of the Advanced Development team, you will play a leading role in the conception, and hands-on development of next-generation plasma process technologies that address both current and future semiconductor manufacturing challenges.
You will be expected to proactively define innovative hardware and process solutions, and lead complex development activities spanning plasma etch, deposition, and advanced process integration. The role requires a deep understanding of plasma-surface interactions, hardware-process interactions, and semiconductor device requirements to create differentiated technology solutions for future KLA products.
Key Responsibilities
Technology Development & Innovation
• Lead the development of breakthrough plasma etch and deposition technologies for Advanced Packaging, Photonics, Compound Semiconductor, Quantum, MEMS, and Specialty Semiconductor applications.
• Solve challenging process and hardware problems where solutions are not immediately apparent, applying a combination of first-principles understanding, simulation, experimental design, and data-driven analysis
• Drive invention activities and contribute to patent generation and intellectual property strategy.
Hardware & Process Leadership
• Lead investigation and resolution of complex process integration, plasma physics, equipment, and hardware performance challenges.
• Guide junior engineers and scientists, sharing technical expertise and best practices.
• Lead technical reviews and influence development priorities across the wider organization
• Work closely with engineering teams to influence chamber design, RF systems, gas delivery, thermal management, endpoint control, and process diagnostics.
Simulation & Modelling
• Interpret modelling tools such as COMSOL or equivalent simulation packages to predict plasma behaviour, materials interactions, process performance, and hardware design impacts.
• Develop physical models and mechanistic understanding to guide future technology directions.
Customer and Partner Engagement
• Collaborate with customers, research institutes, universities, and strategic development partners to understand future technology requirements.
• Act as a technical representative for KLA in customer reviews, consortium activities, technical conferences, and collaborative research programmes.
• Present complex technical findings to internal leadership and external stakeholders.

sanger.wd103.myworkdayjobs.com/wellcomes.description_excerpt:
Do you want to help us improve human health and understand life on Earth? Make your mark by shaping the future to enable or deliver life-changing science to solve some of humanity’s greatest challenges.
We are seeking a highly motivated and creative Postdoctoral Fellow or Senior Postdoctoral Fellow to join the Martin group at the Wellcome Sanger Institute, to develop and apply statistical and machine learning methods to cell-free DNA from pregnant women and people.
About the group:
The Martin group works on the genetic basis of rare and common disease, using large-scale human genetic datasets with rich linkage to electronic health records and questionnaires. Over the last few years, we have had a particular emphasis on the genetics of neurodevelopmental disorders and related traits, the genetics of complex disease in populations with high levels of consanguinity, and factors influencing germline mutation rates.
The group is now opening new research directions involving genomics and multi-omics in very early life. Most conditions in the earliest stages of life remain untouched by large-scale genomics, and molecular predictors that could guide clinical management are urgently needed. We are building a programme spanning a clinical continuum from pregnancy loss, through fetal growth restriction, to complications of premature birth. This includes large-scale sequencing of cell-free DNA (cfDNA) from pregnant women and people to identify monogenic causes of pregnancy loss and identify biomarkers for fetal growth restriction, as well as genetic and multi-omic studies of neonatal conditions using nationwide dried blood spots.
What you'll be doing:
This particular role is focused on cell-free DNA (cfDNA) from pregnant women and people. cfDNA in maternal plasma is a mixture of maternal and fetal (placental) molecules, and offers a route to studying fetal genomes and placental biology at a scale that is impossible with fetal tissue. Possible projects include:
• Developing new statistical and deep learning methods for calling fetal and maternal genotypes from high-coverage sequence data on cfDNA, and for discovering new Mendelian disease genes using the resulting data. These methods will then be applied to study pregnancy complications in large samples.
• Developing biomarkers for pregnancy complications from methylation-aware wholegenome sequence data on cfDNA, including methods development to incorporate both epigenetic and genetic information in the same assay. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with groups at the Norwegian Institute of Public Health (Siri Eldevik Håberg), the University of Helsinki (Simone Rubinacci) and elsewhere.
About you:
We are recruiting at two levels: Postdoctoral Fellow and Senior Postdoctoral Fellow. In both cases, you will have a demonstrable background in statistics or statistical genetics. Experience of working with cfDNA is highly desirable but not essential. The role would particularly suit if you have previously worked on methods for somatic variant calling, or for phasing and imputation from low-coverage sequence data.You would also bring excellent software development skills, since the methods developed here are intended to be applied across several large cohorts and shared with collaborators. The Senior Postdoctoral Fellow role is intended for someone with particularly strong experience in these areas who is ready to work with a high degree of independence, to shape the direction of the methods development, to lead collaborations and to mentor more junior members of the group. You will be considered at the level that best matches your experience, so please apply even if you are unsure which position fits. Prospective candidates are welcome to contact Hilary Martin (hcm@sanger.ac.uk) with informal queries before deciding whether to apply.
Essential Skills:
• PhD in a relevant area (statistics, statistical genetics, genetics, genomics, bioinformatics, machine learning or similar)
• Strong background in statistics or statistical genetics, including the ability to develop, implement and benchmark new statistical methods
• Experience working with raw sequence data (alignments, variant calling, quality control)
• Experience analysing large-scale human genetic or genomic data
• Full working proficiency in Python and/or R, and Unix/Linux
• Experience or enthusiasm for using AI tools to improving productivity in scientific research, statistical methods development and/or software development
• Knowledge and understanding of statistical methods appropriate for large-scale genetic research
• Previous experience writing highly reproducible code with github, Snakemake/Nextflow, RMarkdown or similar
• Experience developing pipelines or software for large-scale analyses of genomic data, including running workflows efficiently on HPC and/or cloud infrastructure
• Creativity and original scientific ideas
• Enthusiasm and commitment
• Attention to detail
• Effective problem-solving skills
• Ability to communicate ideas and results effectively both verbally and in writing
• Ability to prioritise, work independently and organise own workload
• Ability to collaborate effectively with an interdisciplinary team and collaborators
Senior Postdoctoral Fellow as above, with the following additional skills:
• Completion of a previous postdoctoral position, or other highly relevant training or experience
• Experience of developing methods for variant calling from sequence data, or for phasing and imputation from low-coverage sequence data
• Evidence of substantial research contributions and intellectual leadership, demonstrated through publications, methods, software or other relevant outputs, appropriate to career stage and opportunities.
• Specialist knowledge and understanding to drive the project from the outset
• Demonstrated ability to lead collaborations and to supervise or mentor junior researchers
You will join our supportive and collaborative Postdoctoral Fellow community, with access to training, learning and networking across the Institute.
Other information:
For further details, please see role profile for Postdoctoral Fellow and Senior Postdoctoral Fellow.

For Senior Postdoctoral Fellow (dependent upon skills and experience): £44,305-£49,893

Purpose of the Role
The Risk Manager will support the Head of Risk in embedding, maintaining and continuously enhancing the Risk Management Framework across AEGIS London. This role is critical in the identification, assessment and reporting of key risks, ensuring regulatory compliance and alignment with Lloyd’s and broader regulatory expectations.
The Risk Manager will provide clear, commercial and forward-looking risk oversight to support AEGIS London’s strategic objectives. This role sits with the second line of defence Risk Management function. This is great opportunity for someone with demonstrable experience in the field/sector to further advance their career within a high performing syndicate.
​​
Duties and Accountabilities
Risk Management Framework:
• Support the Head of Risk in maintaining and enhancing the Risk Management Framework, including promoting risk awareness, delivering training and supporting risk ownership across the business.
Risk Management Reporting:
• Support the preparation, coordination and delivery of high-quality reporting and documentation for internal and external stakeholders, including committees and working groups.
Risk and Control Registers:
• Ensure that the risks register and associated control documentation remain current, accurate and aligned with the business risk profile, including new and emerging risks; and other stakeholder requirements.
RCSA Process:
• Facilitate a robust Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) process across business functions, ensuring risks and key controls are appropriately assessed, documented and tested.
Risk Event Management:
• Lead the risk event reporting process with the business and work closely with the business to ensure incidents are captured, assessed and monitored.
Risk policies:
• Support the Head of Risk in maintaining and updating risk policies and procedures.
Risk Appetite and Key Risk Indicators:
• Support the development, communication, monitoring and ongoing refinement of risk appetite limits, tolerances, and key risk and control indicators.
Emerging Risks and Opportunities:
• Contribute to the emerging risk identification process, ensuring outputs are integrated into the wider Risk Management Framework.
• This will include leading deep dive assessments.
Operational Risk Scenario Analysis:
• Embed and manage the operational risk scenario assessment process, ensuring effective stress testing and scenario analysis to support the internal model.
Stress and Scenario Testing:
• Support the on-going design, review, reporting of stress and scenario testing across the business.
Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA):
• Manage the on-going development and execution of ORSA processes and procedures, ensuring timely and high quality reporting that meets stakeholder expectations.
• Support the Head of Risk in leading the risk input to the Business Planning process, including preparation of the Risk Opinion.
Internal Model, Validation and Assurance:
• Support governance of the internal model, ensuring that validation activities are designed, planned and executed in line with Lloyd’s standards and regulatory expectations. Ensure that model changes are managed and validated appropriately.
• Conduct aspects of technical validation testing and reporting on validation and assurance of internal and external models used for risk, capital and solvency assessment, ensuring their ongoing appropriateness.
• Complete non-technical validation testing, including the follow up and closure of actions and recommendations from internal and independent validation exercises.
Regulatory Oversight:
• Ensure compliance with UK (Lloyd’s, PRA, FCA) risk management requirements.
• Support delivery of the Lloyd’s Principles Assessment process across AEGIS London.
• Support the Chief Risk and Compliance Officer and Head of Risk in managing effective engagement with regulators, ensuring clear and accurate communication on risk related matters.
​​
Skills, Knowledge and Experience
The successful candidate will be/have:
• Demonstrable years’ worth of Risk Management experience covering key risk types in Lloyd's/London Market.
• Be a strong team player with excellent interpersonal and communication (written, verbal, and presentational).
• Demonstrate proven experience of working effectively with senior management, underwriting teams and business functions across insurance company operations.
• Proactive, highly organised and efficient, with strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail.
• Results-focused, able to structure work effectively, set priorities and deliver to tight deadlines.
• Well versed knowledge of prudential regulatory requirements (Lloyd’s, PRA, Solvency UK/ SII) and associated good practice.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office, and comfortable working with a range of systems, data sources and reporting tools.

• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
Job Responsibilities
Responsibilities:
Leads the clear and accurate completion of complex medical writing deliverables, ensuring scientific information is presented clearly and accurately. Manages medical writing activities associated with individual studies, defining document strategy and coordinating medical writing activities within and across departments with minimal supervision. Leads the resolution of comments from the client.
• Completes a variety of documents that may include clinical study protocols and clinical study protocol amendments; clinical study reports; patient narratives; annual reports; investigator brochures; informed consents; annual reports; plain language summaries; periodic safety update reports, clinical development plans; IND submissions; integrated summary reports; NDA and eCTD submissions; journal manuscripts; and abstracts, posters, and presentations for scientific meetings.
• Adheres to established regulatory standards, including, but not limited to, ICH E3 guidelines, as well as company standard operating procedures, client standards, and company and/or client approved-templates, authorship requirements, and style and formatting guides, when completing medical writing projects, on time and on budget.
• Advises clients and study teams on data presentation and production strategies to ensure that client objectives/expectations are met and quality standards are maintained.
• Leads team document reviews and reviews documents for technical issues. Coordinates quality and editorial reviews and ensures source documentation is managed appropriately.
• Serves as expert peer reviewer for internal team, providing review comments to give maximum clarity of meaning, accuracy, and relevance, and to ensure that client objectives are met and overall quality standards are maintained.
• Reviews statistical analysis plans and table/figure/listing specifications for appropriate content, and for grammar, format, and consistency. Provides feedback to further define statistical output required and document needs.
• Interacts and builds good working relationships with clients, department head, and team members in data management, biostatistics, regulatory affairs, and medical affairs, as necessary, to produce writing deliverables. Works with staff across company to advance company priorities.
• Performs online clinical literature searches and complies with copyright requirements.
• Identifies and proposes solutions to resolve issues, escalating as appropriate. Serves as a key technical SME and contributes to development of internal materials and presentations on needed topics. Contributes to changes to internal process, standard practices, and capabilities.
• Mentors and leads less experienced medical writers on complex documents.
• Develops deep expertise on key topics in the industry and the regulatory requirements and guidelines that affect medical writing. Engages externally with industry groups on industry initiatives.
• Aware of budget specifications for assigned projects, communicating status and changes to medical writing leadership. Contributes to bid projections.
• Communicates status and changes to medical writing leadership; negotiates timelines and assigned deliverables.
• Represents the medical writing department on clinical study teams, at conferences, meetings, and for presentations to the client regarding writing projects.
• Completes required administrative tasks within the specified timeframes.
• Performs other work-related duties as assigned.
• Minimal travel may be required (less than 25%).
Qualifications:
• At least 6 years of relevant experience in science, technical, or medical writing.
• Extensive experience working in the biopharmaceutical, device, or contract research organization industry required.
• Advanced understanding of FDA and ICH regulations and guidelines and/or good publication practices required.
• Extensive experience writing relevant document types required.
• Extensive knowledge of English grammar and able to communicate clearly; strong familiarity with AMA Manual of Style.
Get to know Syneos Health
Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
http://www.syneoshealth.com
